rationales.1: The opening paragraph delivers the whole finding in plain numbers and every year's total and heaviest day are printed as text beside the rail. No per-year onset date appears as a number anywhere, so that one strand is recoverable only from the dot positions or the prose average.
rationales.2: Missing years are drawn as full hatched rows carrying their reason and the 2019 dot is hollow and labelled unverified. The season-total bars are filled from a disclosed 550 to 750 millimetre baseline, so a four percent difference between years reads as a large difference in bar length.
rationales.3: Nulls with their reasons, the instrument-change header, the unverified label and the what-this-page-cannot-say note are all present, and uniquely in this set they all survive at 375 pixels without a horizontally clipped container.
rationales.4: Patient local register throughout, and the interstitial line about anyone laying the lines side by side earns its place at the point the data turns. The two human fragments serve the record rather than decorate it.
rationales.5: Even rail rhythm and a comfortable measure in both modes, with a purpose-built mobile reflow that stacks the totals line above the onset track instead of squeezing the desktop layout.
rationales.6: The renders show a plain static document with a fully readable base and no scroll-driven pacing; no motion or scroll capture was among my inputs, so this is scored on what the renders show.
rationales.7: One sentence carries it, the record read line by line as the almanac the valley used to keep, and content, form and voice all reinforce it. Missing years staying on the page as lines is that idea actually working.
rationales.8: A single break, the almanac rail standing in for a conventional chart, while headings, links and scrolling stay entirely conventional.
rationales.9: Unsensational and rooted in one valley, with phrasing that reads as this paper's own rather than as generic weather copy.
rationales.10: Every mark maps to a field of the record, dot for onset, bar for total, red figure for the worst day, hatch for absence, so nothing is an effect looking for a story.

rationales.1: A then-and-now block, a one-line ink-to-ink difference summary and a full year-by-year table together give a complete path to the finding with no chart decoding required at all.
rationales.2: Missing years are drawn as banded gaps that occupy their own place on the timeline, the seam is marked, era averages are drawn as flat rules rather than trends, and the unverified year is hollow. The vertical scale spans the variable's natural September to mid-October range with no truncation drama.
rationales.3: The instrument caveat is carried by the encoding itself, so every figure travels with its own provenance, alongside explicit null rows, the unverified label and a scope note that declines attribution.
rationales.4: Patient and place-loving, and the line about the record keeping human time as well as rain gives the two fragments a reason to be on the page.
rationales.5: Desktop typography and rhythm are excellent, but at 375 pixels the full-record section sits in a horizontally clipped container that cuts its own introductory paragraph mid-word and pushes the Notes column off screen. The long read is therefore not equally comfortable on both viewports.
rationales.6: The renders show a static document with a fully readable base and no scroll-driven pacing; no motion or scroll capture was among my inputs, so this is scored on what the renders show.
rationales.7: Printed in two inks because the instrument changed is one sentence, and the form is the caveat rather than a decoration on it, reinforced by the deck, the legend, the chart and the table's instrument column.
rationales.8: The two-ink colour system is the single break, and it is backed by the instrument column and the seam line rather than resting on colour alone, with reading mechanics left conventional.
rationales.9: Specific, local and unsensational, and the ledger-in-two-inks framing is prose no other paper could run unchanged.
rationales.10: The two inks come from a documented method change in this dataset rather than from an effects vocabulary, and no device on the page lacks a warrant in the record.

rationales.1: The lede carries the whole finding in numbers, each plate opens with a plain-language account of what it shows, and the full record gives every year's onset day, season total and heaviest day as text.
rationales.2: Gaps break the line and are banded, the unverified year is hollow and excluded from the averages, and the non-zero start is labelled inside the plot area. The instrument seam is only a dashed rule, so era-crossing comparisons depend on the reader carrying that annotation with them.
rationales.3: Nulls, seam, unverified label and scope note appear across all three plates and in the record, but on mobile the table's Notes column, where the null reasons and the unverified caveat live, sits off screen.
rationales.4: The strongest single passage in the set, tying a heavier season to the lane under water in October and the parish answering in its own practical way, with the fragments placed where the data turns.
rationales.5: The plates are cleanly and consistently drawn, but this is much the longest page, the desktop record table carries doubled hairlines and ragged row heights, and the mobile table clips at the viewport edge.
rationales.6: The renders show a static document with a fully readable base and no scroll-driven pacing; no motion or scroll capture was among my inputs, so this is scored on what the renders show.
rationales.7: Three plates with the reporter's notes written on the record is coherent and archetype-true, but it stays close to competent data-journalism convention rather than making the valley's shift felt through the form itself.
rationales.8: Nothing conventional is broken and the reading mechanics are entirely standard, which satisfies the budget without spending any of it.
rationales.9: Patient, concrete and local, with a restraint that reads as a real town paper rather than as a wire summary.
rationales.10: Every mark is a field of the record and the three plates exist because the record holds three measures, so no device is detached from the reporting.
